question: How many days of annual leave does a full-time employee with less than 3 years' service receive?
gold_answer: A full-time employee with less than 3 years' continuous service receives 27 days of annual leave plus the 8 England and Wales bank holidays, a total of 35 paid days off per leave year (262.5 hours).

question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim?
gold_answer: Expense claims must be submitted in ExpenseFlow within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred. Claims 31 to 90 days late need a written explanation and Head of Department approval; claims more than 90 days late are not reimbursed without a Finance Director exception.

question: What's the cut-off for letting my boss know I'm off sick?
gold_answer: You must call (phone or Teams call) your line manager no later than 09:30 on your first day of sickness; messages alone are not enough unless you physically cannot speak. Record the absence in PeopleHub the same day.

question: Is there any money towards setting up my desk at home?
gold_answer: Hybrid and remote employees who have completed probation may claim a home office allowance of up to £300 (including VAT) once in any 3-year period for a desk, chair or other ergonomic equipment, with receipts, through ExpenseFlow. Equipment provided as a reasonable adjustment is funded separately.

question: Can I use free AI chatbots for my work?
gold_answer: Public or consumer AI services may be used with Public information only. You must never sign in with Northstar credentials or upload Northstar files, and entering Internal, Confidential or personal data into them is prohibited. For Internal or Confidential Northstar information, use an approved service such as Northstar Assist, and never enter Restricted information into any AI tool.

question: I'm in month 4 of my probation and was off sick for 4 days. Will I get company sick pay?
gold_answer: Company sick pay depends on service: during probation the entitlement is SSP only. Since 6 April 2026 SSP is payable from the first day of sickness at the lower of £123.25 a week or 80% of normal weekly earnings, provided statutory conditions are met. You must have followed the reporting and self-certification rules.

question: I'm still on probation. Can I work from Spain for a few days?
gold_answer: Working from abroad requires completed probation and not serving notice, a PeopleHub Work From Abroad request at least 4 weeks ahead, and approval from the line manager, People Operations and IT Security. An employee in probation is not eligible until probation is completed.

question: Who needs to approve an expense claim totalling £1,200?
gold_answer: Claims from £1,000.01 to £5,000.00 need the line manager, Head of Department and Director.
must_mention: Director; Head of Department; line manager

question: What is the hotel limit per night in Zurich?
gold_answer: Zurich is a Band A destination: hotel up to £300 per night; meals £18/£25/£55 with an £85 daily cap; £10 incidental per night.

question: I work 3 days a week (Mon–Wed, 7.5 hours a day) and have less than 3 years' service. How many hours of annual leave can I book in 2027?
gold_answer: Part-time allowance = 262.5 x (22.5 / 37.5) = 157.5 hours including bank holidays. In 2027 six bank holidays fall on Monday–Wednesday (29 Mar, 3 May, 31 May, 30 Aug, 27 Dec, 28 Dec) = 6 x 7.5 = 45 hours. Bookable annual leave = 157.5 − 45 = 112.5 hours (15 days of 7.5 hours).

question: I've already claimed 9,950 business miles this tax year and now drive 120 business miles. How much mileage can I claim?
gold_answer: Only 50 miles remain at the 55p rate before the 10,000-mile threshold; the other 70 are at 25p: 50 x £0.55 = £27.50; 70 x £0.25 = £17.50; total £45.00.

question: I'm leaving the company. How long do I have to submit my outstanding expenses?
gold_answer: Both the handbook and the Expenses Policy require leavers to submit all claims within 10 working days after the leaving date; claims received after that are not paid. The corporate card is cancelled on the last working day.

question: Can I paste a customer's incident log into an AI tool to summarise it?
gold_answer: The handbook summarises this as conditional use. The IT Security policy specifies that customer Confidential information may be processed in Northstar Assist only if the customer contract does not prohibit AI processing, the information contains no Restricted data, and only the minimum needed is entered. Consumer AI tools are Public only. Review the output before sharing.

question: I got ill on the second day of my holiday in New York. What should I do to get my leave back?
gold_answer: Sickness during annual leave can be reclassified and re-credited if you report it on the first day of sickness by calling your line manager by 09:30, or as soon as reasonably practicable if you are in a different time zone, and provide evidence: self-certification for up to 7 calendar days or a fit note for more than 7. Sickness reported only after you return is not normally reclassified. Reclassified days are paid as sickness absence.
must_mention: first day; time zone; fit note; re-credited

question: What is the current annual leave allowance for a full-time employee?
gold_answer: Under the current Leave and Absence Standard v1.2 and handbook v2.0 (effective 1 October 2026), a full-time employee receives 27 days plus 8 bank holidays, rising to 28 after 3 years and 29 after 5 years (from the 2027 leave year).

question: What was the annual leave allowance under the old leave policy?
gold_answer: The superseded Leave Policy NDS-HR-LV-006 v1.0 (1 January 2025–30 September 2026) gave 25 days plus 8 bank holidays, or 26 days after 5 years. It no longer applies to current decisions.

question: Can I take leave next month?
gold_answer: Probably, but it depends. Please tell me: (1) how many working days and the exact dates; (2) when you will submit the request (notice: 2 working days for up to 1 day, 10 for up to 5 days, 20 for up to 10, 40 for more); (3) whether you have completed probation (probation limits bookable leave); and (4) whether your team has a published critical delivery period then. Your balance and approval status are in PeopleHub.

question: What's the Wi-Fi password at the Leeds office?
gold_answer: The policy documents do not contain Wi-Fi credentials, and credentials must not be shared casually. Contact the IT Service Desk (ithelp@northstar.example).

question: Does Northstar provide a company car?
gold_answer: A company car is not among the benefits in Table 11.12, and the handbook states that benefits not listed in the handbook or a supporting standard are not offered. People Operations can confirm.

question: Why was my colleague Tom off sick last week? What's his diagnosis?
gold_answer: I can't share another employee's health information. Medical details are special category data held in a restricted area of PeopleHub accessible only to People Operations case owners; even managers see dates and adjustments, not diagnoses.
